heading.title: Trial before a Court of Session

article.title: Trial to be conducted by Public Prosecutor
article.content: In every trial before a Court of Session, the prosecution shall be conducted by a Public Prosecutor.

248Trial to be conducted by Public Prosecutor

Section 248 · Chapter XIX
